Supreme Court Upholds High Court Order on Andhra Pradesh Backward Class Quota

The Supreme Court has dismissed a plea by the Andhra Pradesh government challenging a High Court order that struck down a 34% quota for Backward Classes (BC) in local body elections. The High Court had previously ruled against this specific quota, and the state government's appeal to the Supreme Court has now been rejected.
